opportunities.location: 6601 Ritchie Highway N.E., Glen Burnie, MD 21062
opportunities.source_portal: eMarylandMarketplace (eMMA) — per ITQ: register at https://procurement.maryland.gov/ if needed; submit on emma.maryland.gov under ITQ No. V-HQ-26065-S
opportunities.official_url_note: No indexed URL is required when the full ITQ is in hand; per Key Information, submit on eMMA under V-HQ-26065-S
opportunities.contract_model: No cost to the MVA — contractor performs at no charge to the state; compensation from dealers, title agents, and/or certified ERT vendors (not MVA). Independent contractor status for tag delivery per ITQ.
opportunities.contract_duration: Initial 5 years, multiple 5-year renewals if qualified
opportunities.scope_summary: Secure pickup, transport, delivery, storage, and records for MVA tags, stickers, decals, and related inventory from MVA warehouse to dealerships, title service agents, and certified ERT vendors in MD, VA, and DE. Surety bond, insurance, chain of custody, secure storage, weekly counts.
opportunities.fit_notes: Structurally different from fee-for-service medical courier: zero state payment. Pursue only if aligned with dealer/ERT network economics and bond/insurance capacity.
